metadata.issueBody:
## Problem
During tip-unblock work on #5802 / PR #5803, the implement leaf pushed the first tip-unblock commit **without** running the always-pin `deft-directive-pre-pr` Read-Write-Lint-Diff-Loop (formerly RWDL).

That skip let failures reach CI / Greptile that local pre-PR would have caught:
- Biome **format** errors on deposit/verify-hooks test files we edited
- `branches.test.ts` shared fixture still on legacy `preflight-gh` after `verify-hooks-installed` required OVPR `verify:branch`

Operator had to ask explicitly whether pre-PR/RWDL ran. Second push fixed after a proper iteration-lane pass (biome + pack-drift + affected vitest).

## Why this is a framework gap
`deft-directive-pre-pr` is an **always-pin** process skill (AGENTS.md / skill-pin-policy #2508) specifically because false-negatives here are expensive. A leaf can still open/push a product PR while only narrating "pre-PR" or skipping the loop entirely — there is no hard local refuse before `git push` / `gh pr create` that proves a controller `deft pre-pr:run` pass (#4912).

Related surfaces already exist but did not stop this session:
- Skill pin + SKILL.md obligation
- `deft pre-pr:run` controller (#4912) — not invoked
- Pre-push hooks on tip OVPR are encoding/branch only — they do **not** require pre-PR attestation

## What to build
Make skipped pre-PR fail closed for product pushes on this repo (or a policy-gated set of repos):
- Require a fresh `deft pre-pr:run` pass (or equivalent attested merge-chokepoint) before `git push` / first `gh pr create` on feature branches carrying product/test/doc changes.
- Or a pre-push / verify verb that refuses when no bound pre-PR record exists for `HEAD` (Limb enrollment / #4976 class).
- Agent-facing: short recovery line when refuse fires (`deft pre-pr:run` then retry push).
- Eval / dogfood: a case where narrating pre-PR without controller run is scored fail.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A feature-branch push of product/test changes without a bound pre-PR pass for that HEAD fails closed with a remediation pointing at `deft pre-pr:run`.
- [ ] A completed `deft pre-pr:run` for the same HEAD allows push.
- [ ] Docs/skill pin cite the hard gate (not only prose obligation).
- [ ] Recurrence of "biome/format fixture reaches Greptile because RWDL was skipped" is prevented by the gate, not by operator memory.

## Evidence
- PR https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/5803 first tip `9851e2e9a` — CI biome format red + Greptile P1 on `branches.test.ts` fixture.
- Operator question: "are you doing rwldl skill on pre-pr? that should have caught some of this".
- Follow-up fix commit `383da7f91` after local RWDL: biome 0, pack-drift 55/55 sync, affected vitest 225 passed.

## Keep-outs
- Do not weaken tip OVPR hook gates to compensate for missing pre-PR.
- Do not treat reading SKILL.md or claiming "I ran lint" as a pre-PR pass (#4912).
- Docs-only / explicit process-only pushes may keep a narrow attested skip — product/test/doc-code changes must not.
